europe_now.title: Russian Strikes and Sanctions Debate
europe_now.summary: Russian military strikes in Zaporizhzhia and eastern regions resulted in numerous casualties and infrastructure damage. The attacks occurred shortly after the United States eased diesel sanctions on Moscow, prompting sharp criticism from Ukrainian leadership.

europe_now.title: EU Budget Discussions
europe_now.summary: A proposed Irish initiative to reduce the European Union budget by 159 billion euros has drawn scrutiny from member states. Germany indicated that the currently proposed financial cuts do not go far enough to address institutional requirements.

sources.headline: Germany warns EU that €159B budget cuts are not enough
EU budget slashed by €159B in new Irish proposal

top_stories.title: Escalating Conflict in Ukraine
top_stories.summary: Russian strikes across Zaporizhzhia and eastern Ukraine caused multiple fatalities and widespread disruptions. Regional authorities and international observers reported significant civilian casualties and power outages following the bombardment.
